title: Modernization pod kit: a dependency-upgrade skill and the pod playbook
scenario: You lead the pod moving ClaimDesk to JDK 21, EAP 8 and Okta with four developers of mixed experience, each running an agent. Agents have already truncated evidence, rewritten golden files, silenced warnings with --add-opens and produced a 1,900-file commit. The sponsor wants a skill and a playbook that make those failures hard to repeat.
task: Write skill/dependency-upgrade/SKILL.md: triggers, tool steps, verification, approval STOPs, a never list, 6-10 eval cases
Slice the program into owned, verifiable, revertible increments
Define the gates, a review rubric for agent PRs and a failure-mode log format
Assign the work to the roster and plan the mentoring
acceptance: The skill would have stopped each logged incident and verifies itself
Increments fit the change windows and each has one verifiable outcome and a rollback
Human gates sit where the risk is; the review rubric targets agent failure modes
The failure log feeds back into the skill (rubric)
